notes.title: The Steam page has launched!
notes.content:
[h1]💊 Pharmacy Management Simulator[/h1]

Hey Pharmacy Team!

I’m thrilled to announce that the Steam page for Pharmacy Management Simulator has finally launched. It’s been a long time coming and I appreciate everyone’s patience. 

 [h1]🕹️ Playtesting[/h1]

Playtesting for Pharmacy Management Simulator will start soon!  If you’d like to participate in the closed playtest [b]join the mailing list [/b]at [url=https://www.quantumvialgames.com/]www.quantumvialgames.com[/url] to be notified.

The game’s Discord server is not open yet, but will be when the playtest begins. You will receive the server link in the newsletter.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509550?utm_source=all&utm_campaign=spl&utm_medium=ste&utm_content=16]Interested in becoming a pharmacist? Wishlist Pharmacy Management Simulator![/url][/h1]

I’m thankful for everyone’s continued support during development. I’m excited to have new folks join the community. Feel free to reach out to me on the medium of your choice with any questions, I look forward to hearing from you! 

Cheers :)

Cole
